name: Ro-5-3335
summary: Ro5-3335 is an experimental drug from the benzodiazepine family which acts as a selective inhibitor of the protein Runt-related transcription factor 1 (RUNX1).

pharmacology.text: Ro5-3335 is an experimental drug from the benzodiazepine family which acts as a selective inhibitor of the protein Runt-related transcription factor 1 (RUNX1).

uses.en: It is used only in laboratory research and is not a medicine.
uses.zh: 它僅用於實驗室研究，並不是藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它仅用于实验室研究，并不是药物。

fact.en: Ro5-3335 looks like a benzodiazepine but does something quite different: it interferes with RUNX1, a protein that switches genes on and off in blood cells, which is why it is studied in leukaemia research.
fact.zh: Ro5-3335 看起來像苯二氮平，作用卻完全不同：它會干擾 RUNX1，一種在血球中開關基因的蛋白質，因此被用於白血病研究。
fact.zhHans: Ro5-3335 看起来像苯二氮平，作用却完全不同：它会干扰 RUNX1，一种在血球中开关基因的蛋白质，因此被用于白血病研究。
